offering_description.value: Operates for-profit postsecondary education institutions that deliver online and campus-based degree and certificate programs. Serves military service members, veterans, public safety professionals, nursing and healthcare students, and other adult learners. Revenue comes mainly from tuition paid by students, government tuition assistance and federal student aid.

primary_services.value: online degree programs; certificate programs; nursing and healthcare education; career and technical training

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult students, military service members, veterans, nurses and healthcare students; B2G: military tuition assistance and federal student aid funding; B2B: employer and partner tuition arrangements

end_markets.value: higher education; military and veteran education; healthcare and nursing education; public safety education

revenue_model.value: service fees: tuition and fees paid by students, funded by federal aid, military tuition assistance or self-pay

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates accredited universities and nursing schools, serving students

geography_served.value: US national: Online students across the US and military personnel worldwide, campuses in several states

specialization.value: related lines: military-focused online university, nursing and health sciences schools, and career education

distribution_channels.value: online: online enrollment and course delivery platform; own locations: Rasmussen and Hondros physical campuses and training sites; direct sales: enrollment advisors and military/employer partnerships

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Title IV federal student aid, Department of Education, accreditors, state authorization, and DoD tuition assistance rules
